lines: Tu kahin bhi rahe, sar par tere ilzaam to hai
couplets.en: Wherever you may be, the blame still follows you.

lines: Tere haathon ki lakeeron mein mera naam to hai
couplets.en: My name, at least, is written in the lines of your hands.

lines: Tu kahin bhi rahe, sar par tere
couplets.en: Wherever you may be, you still carry it.

lines: Mujhko tu apna bana ya na bana, teri khushi
couplets.en: Whether you make me yours is yours to decide.

lines: Tu zamaane mein mere naam se badnaam to hai
couplets.en: It is my name that has brought you shame in the eyes of the world.

lines: Tu kahin bhi rahe, sar par tere
couplets.en: Wherever you may be, you still carry it.

lines: Mere hisse mein koi jaam na aaya, na sahi
couplets.en: If no cup fell to my share, so be it.

lines: Teri mehfil mein mere naam koi shaam to hai
couplets.en: Some evening in your gathering still bears my name.

lines: Tu kahin bhi rahe, sar par tere
couplets.en: Wherever you may be, you still carry it.

lines: Dekh kar log mujhe naam tera lete hain
couplets.en: When people see me, they speak your name.

lines: Is par main khush hoon, mohabbat ka ye anjaam to hai
couplets.en: I am glad that love has come to this, at least.

lines: Tu kahin bhi rahe, sar par tere
couplets.en: Wherever you may be, you still carry it.

lines: Woh sitamgar hi sahi, dekh ke usko, Sabir
couplets.en: Cruel though they may be, Sabir, the sight of them is enough.

lines: Shukr hai is dil-e-bimaar ko aaraam to hai
couplets.en: I am thankful this ailing heart has found some rest.

lines: Tu kahin bhi rahe, sar par tere ilzaam to hai
couplets.en: Wherever you may be, the blame still follows you.
